sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN shipping_policy_version>=1 THEN final_amount-COALESCE(shipping_fee,0) ELSE final_amount END),0) revenue FROM orders WHERE payment_status='PAID' AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','DELIVERY_FAILED') AND created_at>=CONVERT(date,GETDATE()) AND created_at<DATEADD(day,1,CONVERT(date,GETDATE()))
